description: This PHP source file defines the 'ConfiguratorViewAddFontResult' class, which handles the display and processing of font addition results within the SuiteCRM Configurator module. It manages file uploads, interacts with the FontManager, and ensures only admin users can perform these actions.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewAddFontResult
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that handles font addition result display, including upload processing and interaction with the FontManager.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the font addition result page, validates admin access, and shows success or error messages.

methods.name: addFont
methods.description: Processes uploaded font files and metadata, interacts with FontManager to add a font, and logs the process outcome.
